outcome: Composite respiratory outcome (oxygen saturation less than 95% lasting 30+ seconds or need for respiratory support)
cohort: 2,230 opioid-naive women undergoing cesarean birth between January 2016 and December 2017
finding: The proportion of women experiencing respiratory events following cesarean birth increases with the degree of obesity and opioid dose.
mod_finding: The proportion of women experiencing respiratory events following cesarean birth increases with the degree of obesity and opioid dose.
